page_title: WER 2-2 EIN | Werder Bremen v Eintracht Frankfurt 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Benjamin Brand has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' The attendance is 42100.
90+2' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Omar Marmoush will be replaced by Nacho (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90+1' Substitution. Marvin Ducksch will be replaced by Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen).
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.

90+1' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Werder Bremen force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
87' Michael Zetterer comes off his line to intercept the corner from Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt).

86' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
85' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
84' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for an infringement. Werder Bremen have a free kick.
83' A dangerous towering header by Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
83' Good work from Eintracht Frankfurt as they win a corner.
83' Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
82' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Rafael Borre is replaced by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).

82' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) darts to the edge of the box to meet the ball from the free kick and sends a header towards the middle of the target. One of the defending players gets in its way and blocks it.

80' Hrvoje Smolcic (Eintracht Frankfurt) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Werder Bremen will take a free kick.

75' 2 - 2 Goal! Tuta peels away from his marker to connect with the resulting free kick and heads the ball towards Hrvoje Smolcic (Eintracht Frankfurt), who does brilliantly to nod the ball into the net. He makes it 2:2.
74' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) makes a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt in a dangerous position.

70' A cross by Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a throw-in.
68' A short pass finds Hrvoje Smolcic (Eintracht Frankfurt). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
67' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but it's cleared.
67' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Eintracht Frankfurt have a corner.
66' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) replacing Leonardo Bittencourt.

65' 2 - 1 Omar Marmoush produces a killer pass to release Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt), who then unleashes a low drive from the edge of the box and scores! The ball goes in off the left post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. 2:1!
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt) is replacing Ansgar Knauff.
64' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
62' The ball is cleared after Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
60' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

59' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
58' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a terrific long ball forward to Mario Gotze, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
56' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Philipp Max.
55' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
54' That's a well-taken pass by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
52' Referee Benjamin Brand points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Werder Bremen players celebrate.
51' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Werder Bremen players aren’t happy.

50' 2 - 0 Leonardo Bittencourt displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it in off the left post – 2:0.
46' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Benjamin Brand didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Mario Gotze comes on the pitch for Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' It will be a substitution. Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) is ready to enter the pitch as Buta walks off.
46' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' 1 - 0 Goal! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Kevin Trapp.
45+2' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+2' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).

45+1' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised for holding. Benjamin Brand signals a set piece. PENALTY! One of the players from Werder Bremen is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
45+1' The resulting corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared.

45+1' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the left side of the goal, but Michael Zetterer made a crucial save! The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benjamin Brand saw the whole situation.
41' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes high over the bar.
41' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
40' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) tries to find Marvin Ducksch, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball has crossed the sideline. Eintracht Frankfurt are taking a throw-in.
38' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but Kevin Trapp reacts well to deny him. His shot went towards the middle of the goal.
37' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benjamin Brand had an easy-decision to make.
37' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
35' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post.
35' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
34' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
33' The game is interrupted as Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is flagged offside.
31' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

28' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) sends a long ball forward to Olivier Deman, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
27' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
25' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
25' The corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted by the defence.

25' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
22' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Dangerous play by William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt). Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
20' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
19' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a corner.
18' Wasted opportunity! Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
18' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
18' An attempted cross from Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is cleared. Werder Bremen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

16' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Benjamin Brand with no other option than to blow for a foul.
15' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
14' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Werder Bremen will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
11' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
10' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
8' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
6' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Werder Bremen.
3' Eintracht Frankfurt are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Werder Bremen will kick-off.
Benjamin Brand is the one to supervise the game today.
